newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan boys nabbed for robbing T$5 (18 U.S. cents).
newsitem.headline: Taiwan boys nabbed for robbing T$5 (18 U.S. cents).

text.p: Two boys, aged nine and 10, wielded a knife and a club to rob an 11-year-old boy of just $T5 (18 U.S. cents), Taiwan police said on Friday.
Police said they arrested the pair as they wandered the streets of Taipei late on Thursday night.
"Although it is only five dollars, we still had to detain the boys and send them for trial at a juvenile court," a Taipei police spokeswoman said by telephone.
